questions.question: A hollow metal sphere of radius 5 cm is charged such that the potential on its surface is 10 V. The potential at the centre of the sphere is

answers.c: Same as at a point 5 cm away from the surface
answers.d: Same as at a point 10 cm away from the surface

questions.question: What happens when we separate insulated copper spheres of radii 10 cm and 15 cm, having equal charges which are initially connected by a copper wire?

answers.a: Charges on both sphere become zero
answers.b: Charges on 15 cm sphere will be greater than that on 10 cm sphere
answers.c: Charges on 10 cm sphere will be greater than that on 15 cm sphere
answers.d: Both spheres will have the same charge
